decisions.reason: The product builds on the firm's established coolant and pumping knowledge, and in-house R&D supports learning and improvement.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge builds on existing filtration and pumping expertise, and related R&D capability enables interpretation of early results.
Coolant nozzles build on the firm's established fluid handling offer, and own R&D supports assimilation and commercial learning.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to the firm's conveying expertise, and with own R&D the firm can still interpret and improve it, though slightly less directly aligned than building-on products.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds on the firm's established conveyor and material handling knowledge, supported by in-house R&D.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is close to existing conveying systems, and while related, it is slightly less central than building-on products, yet still kept due to absorptive capacity from R&D.
